text: {"lessons":["A few months of mostly flat account values are not enough to judge my strategy; I should make decisions from a longer-term plan, not short-term fluctuations.","Buying all five stocks at once leaves me invested across them but doesn’t guarantee meaningful diversification; I should understand my exposure and keep enough cash for flexibility.","I’m investing toward an apartment within ten years, so I should balance growth with risk and continue investing regularly rather than chase quick gains."]}
